events.title: Diwali Grand Feast & Musical DJ Night with live tandoori paneer, sweets, and festive poster
events.subtitle: Special announcement from the Chandigarh University Mess Council
events.description:
We are thrilled to announce: Diwali Grand Feast & Musical DJ Night with live tandoori paneer, sweets, and festive poster!

Join us for an unforgettable evening featuring handpicked chef specials, festive decor, and great campus vibes. All hostellers across NC, Zakir, and Girls blocks are invited. Please bring your student ID card for smooth entry.
highlights: Chef Signature Delicacies & Fresh Tandoori Dishes
events.author: Ankit Pandey (Hostel Admin)

events.title: Diwali Grand Hostel Feast & Musical DJ Night
events.subtitle: Grand 7-course festive dinner with unlimited sweets and music
events.venue: Central Lawn & Block 3 Grand Dining Hall
events.description: Celebrate the Festival of Lights with our biggest hostel feast of the year! Enjoy live tandoor stations, authentic Awadhi Dum Biryani, Shahi Paneer, Kesari Rasmalai, and an open DJ dance floor under the festive lighting.
highlights: Live DJ Setup & Ethnic Dress Code Contest
Free Entry for all CU Hostel Residents
events.author: Ankit Pandey (Hostel Secretary)

events.title: Mega Sunday Special Biryani & Ice Cream Gala
events.subtitle: Special weekend treat curated by the Student Mess Committee
events.venue: All Campus Mess Halls (NC, Zakir, LC & Girls Wing)
events.description: Get ready for Sunday delight! Savor our slow-cooked aromatic Vegetable & Soy Dum Biryani paired with refreshing Burani Raita, Salan, and Chilled Choco-Chip Cones.
highlights: Double Ka Meetha & Choco-Chip Ice Cream
Fast-track express counters for rush management
events.author: CU Mess Welfare Council

events.title: Hostel Premier League Finals Live Screening & Snacks
events.subtitle: Live match on giant LED screen with hot samosas & cold drinks
events.description: Cheer for your hostel team in the Grand Finals! Mess team will be serving piping hot paneer samosas, potato wedges, and cold drinks throughout the match.
events.author: Sports & Mess Committee
